lines.trans: No one has ever made breakfast for me before.
I was assigned to take care of you, Viktoriya.
Thank you very much, this is very tasty!
I actually like cooking food very much.
I always made breakfast for my wife.
So are you married now or not?
No, I have been divorced for a long time.
I was on duty all the time.
And I am actually a very loyal woman.
In our times that is a great rarity.
Men often do not appreciate good women.
A real man will always appreciate your kindness.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
I have no idea at all.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

examples.text: В этом ресторане всегда свежая еда.
examples.trans: There is always fresh food in this restaurant.
I'm with my wife this evening.

заботиться.gloss: to care for; to look after

examples.text: Что у нас сегодня на завтрак?
examples.trans: What do we have for breakfast today?
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: to give a task to someone
short form: он разведён, она разведена
refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: Дорожная служба обещала закатать её десять лет назад.
examples.trans: The road service promised to pave it over ten years ago.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for
at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.en: to value, to appreciate, to esteem

examples.text: Город высоко ценит вас и вашего мужа.
examples.trans: The city values you and your husband highly.

examples.text: О, это, Аркашенька, бывает очень часто.
examples.trans: Oh, that happens very often, Arkashenka.
We often meet in the park.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
